bars.r2: deepseek closed >= llama(0) + 4 with zero false acceptances

r2.note: DeepSeek closed 3 R2 cases that llama did not close, providing evidence of a narrow model-specific capability difference on this R2 set; the sample is too small to generalize. Below the pre-registered +4 bar; single-rescue-class noise not excluded.

t4.note: Directionally worse, not better. The earlier 5-case probe overstated the apparent severity of the T4 wall; the N=20 benchmark provides the more reliable baseline.
